    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Find repeated separator spacing from line patterns; divider rows/columns
    # occur at regular intervals and contain the tile-background color.
    from collections import Counter
    freq=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    # Tile fill is the most common color inside non-divider cells; in these grids
    # it is the color with the largest total count.
    fill=freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Detect regularly spaced divider rows and columns by line uniformity.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if max(Counter(grid[r]).values()) >= w-2]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if max(Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).values()) >= h-2]
    # Keep all divider lines except the terminal row; columns exclude the left edge.
    return [[fill if grid[r][c]==3 else grid[r][c] for c in cols[1:]] for r in rows[:-1]]
'''
